attempts.summary: Configured dnsmasq on node1 (RHEL 7) to resolve inventory-api.internal to node2's IP (10.100.97.11) while forwarding all other queries upstream; configured node2's NetworkManager DNS to use node1 (10.100.97.10) as its resolver. Verified resolution both directions and re-verified after restarting each node one at a time with preserved connectivity throughout.
